net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0

cat /etc/sysctl.d/60-icmp-source-route-hardening.conf

for f in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_redirects; do echo "$f: $(cat "$f")"; done
